armor_graphite.treatment: Graphite steel with broad restrained tonal wear and fine low-amplitude surface breakup.

mask_nearblack.treatment: Near-black respirator and face hardware with smooth, subdued surface variation.

metal_bronze.treatment: Aged bronze and brass with restrained patina variation; geometry supplies hoops and relief.

fabric_offwhite.treatment: Pale matte cloth with broad value folds and subtle object-space weave; opaque torn edges remain geometry.

fabric_burgundy.treatment: Maroon lining and cloth panels with broad low-contrast folds and subtle object-space weave.

fabric_charcoal.treatment: Charcoal cloak cloth with restrained broad folds and subtle object-space weave.

soft_underarmor.treatment: Muted gray flexible underarmor and sleeve fabric, separated in value from plates.

leather_dark.treatment: Dark worn leather for harnesses and pouches, with fine grain and no projected imagery.

cable_ochre.treatment: Solid ochre insulated cable surface; cable loop silhouette comes from geometry.

emblem_ivory.treatment: Opaque ivory high-contrast geometric shoulder symbol.

emission_amber.treatment: Opaque amber energy surface with independent emissive Principled shader.
